title: Employ staff under the Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020.

laws.title: Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020

sources.title: Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020
sources.quote: This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the broadcasting, recorded entertainment and cinema industry and their employees in the classifications set out in this award to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020
sources.quote: Broadcasting, recorded entertainment and cinema industry means the production (including pre-production and post-production)

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).
